settings.photo_alt: An adult in a bathroom mirror holding a thin round patch next to a small spot on the chin
settings.title: The spot that picked today
settings.text: You spot it in the mirror and suddenly it is all you can see.
settings.fix: Hold a thin, low-shine day patch over it. It sits close to the skin, so you can get on with your day.

settings.photo_alt: A fingertip pressing a thin round patch onto a small spot on the chin
settings.title: Fingers on autopilot
settings.text: Your hand finds the spot before your brain catches up. Picking is the habit to break.
settings.fix: Press a patch on once. It covers the spot, so there is nothing to touch or pick.

settings.photo_alt: An adult lying in bed at night with a thin round patch on a small spot on the chin
settings.title: Will it stay on?
settings.text: Patches lift at the edges, curl up, and end up on the pillow instead of your face.
settings.fix: Our night patch is thicker and more cushioned, made to stay put while you sleep.

settings.photo_alt: A used patch that has turned white in the middle beside a fresh clear patch, each held on a fingertip
settings.title: Is it done? Check the middle.
settings.text: Not sure when to peel it off, or whether to put on a fresh one?
settings.fix: When the middle turns white, the patch has taken in as much fluid as it can hold. Peel it off and add a fresh one if the spot is still there.

settings.title: Absorbs
settings.text: Draws fluid out of the surface of the spot into the patch.

settings.title: Covers
settings.text: Keeps the spot covered and protected from touching and picking.

settings.title: Drug-free
settings.text: No medicated actives. It simply covers the spot.

settings.title: Cleanse and dry
settings.text: Wash your face gently and pat dry. Patches stick best to clean, dry skin.

settings.title: Press for 10 seconds
settings.text: Place the patch over the spot and press from the center out so the edges seal.

settings.title: Leave on 6–8 hours
settings.text: Wear it for 6–8 hours, or until the patch turns white, which means it has taken in as much fluid as it can hold.

settings.title: Peel and swap
settings.text: Peel from an edge, toss it, and add a fresh patch if the spot is still there.

settings.question: What is ZLOFY Stack Pro?
settings.answer: A day and night set of drug-free hydrocolloid patches. Day patches are thin and low-shine, night patches are thicker and more cushioned. Both cover and protect surfaced spots.

settings.question: How long do I wear a patch?
settings.answer: Leave a patch on for 6–8 hours, or until it turns white. Change it sooner if the edges lift.

settings.question: Can I wear makeup over the day patch?
settings.answer: You can try it: press the patch flat, then dab a thin layer of your usual product around the edges. Avoid rubbing, which can lift the patch.

settings.question: Does it work on deep or cystic bumps?
settings.answer: No. These patches are made for surfaced spots, the kind with a visible head. They are not designed for deep, under-the-skin bumps. If a breakout is painful, large or keeps coming back, see a dermatologist.

settings.question: Is it okay for sensitive skin?
settings.answer: The patches are drug-free hydrocolloid with no active ingredients. Everyone's skin is different, so try one on a small area first. Stop using it if you notice irritation, and contact us.
